legend: A low-power view of ductal carcinoma in situ associated with Paget disease.
Higher-power view showing a comedo growth pattern.

Isolated or small clusters of Paget cells invading through the basement membrane into the superficial dermis. Infiltrating cells are large with abundant pale cytoplasm, histologically similar to the intraepidermal Paget cells.
